sections.title: II. Read the following passage and mark the letter A, B, C, or D on your answer sheet to indicate the correct answer to each of the questions. (1.0 point)
sections.introHtml: Nam’s grandparents live in a nice, small house in the countryside. There isn’t a school, a bookshop, a hotel, a hospital, or a restaurant near it but there is a long river. There is a rice paddy behind the house. There is a rice paddy in front of it, too. To the left of the house is a small market. To the right of the house is a big garden. His grandparents grow a lot of vegetables and flowers in the garden. He loves them and their house very much. It is quiet and peaceful. He visits it every summer.
